title: ‘So surreal’: woman gives birth while stuck in heavy San Francisco traffic
summary_full: Doula stopped to assist couple with birth while first responders were also stuck in traffic and arrived on footA woman stuck in heavy traffic in San Francisco went into labor and gave birth to a healthy baby girl, local authorities have said.The San Francisco fire department said in a statement that a couple had been snarled in heavy congestion near the city’s Golden Gate Park when they were forced to pull over due to the imminent birth.
